item.text: The workspace is a minimal scaffold with no existing project store, auth middleware, or build pipeline. I’m going to add a small in-memory service with an explicit project-admin registry (including a documented demo project), so authorization is real and testable rather than inferred from untrusted request data. The API will remain additive and dependency-free.

The implementation is in place: server-side bearer authentication and admin authorization, validated invite creation, stable idempotency behavior, an accessible form with status announcements, and a contract/trust-boundary document. I’m now exercising success and failure paths and checking the running browser/API entry point.

item.text:
Implemented the first version of self-serve project invitations.

- Added authenticated invite API with viewer/editor roles.
- Added server-side project-admin authorization and input validation.
- Added idempotency replay and conflict handling.
- Added accessible browser form with status feedback.
- Documented product contract and trust boundary in [docs/invitations.md](/workspace/docs/invitations.md).
- Added focused API tests and a build check.

Verified:

- `npm test` — 2 tests passing.
- `npm run build` — passing.
- Live API smoke test — successful invite creation.
- Browser page loads successfully.

Remaining limitation: invite and idempotency data are in-memory and reset on restart, as documented.
